content: The execution was successful (Reward 1.0). The primary factor for success was the precise removal of `hp:linesegarray` elements using DOM-based manipulation (`paragraph.remove(child)`) rather than regex. By iterating through all children of a modified paragraph and checking the local name of the tag (case-insensitive), we avoided the layout cache issues that typically cause HWPX verification failures. Additionally, registering all namespaces before parsing ensured the output XML remained valid for the HWPX format.
